name: Shout Out
summary: A team chat composer where @ and # open live suggestions, picks turn into pills and pings fly out
about: A message box for a small shop team. Type @ to search teammates or # to search topics: a list opens under the caret with the typed letters marked, and your pick becomes a coloured pill right inside the text. Send it and the bubble rises into the thread, every mentioned teammate bounces with a badge, ticks confirm delivery and the first person you named types a reply.
how: Type @ and a few letters (or press @, # or a teammate's face) to open suggestions
Use the Up and Down arrows and Enter or Tab to pick, or click a name; Escape closes the list
Backspace straight after a pill removes the whole mention in one go
Press Enter or the send button; Shift+Enter adds a new line and an empty message shakes
